#====================================================================================================
# START - Testing Protocol - DO NOT EDIT OR REMOVE THIS SECTION
#====================================================================================================

# THIS SECTION CONTAINS CRITICAL TESTING INSTRUCTIONS FOR BOTH AGENTS
# BOTH MAIN_AGENT AND TESTING_AGENT MUST PRESERVE THIS ENTIRE BLOCK

# Communication Protocol:
# If the `testing_agent` is available, main agent should delegate all testing tasks to it.
#
# You have access to a file called `test_result.md`. This file contains the complete testing state
# and history, and is the primary means of communication between main and the testing agent.
#
# Main and testing agents must follow this exact format to maintain testing data. 
# The testing data must be entered in yaml format Below is the data structure:
# 
## user_problem_statement: {problem_statement}
## backend:
##   - task: "Task name"
##     implemented: true
##     working: true  # or false or "NA"
##     file: "file_path.py"
##     stuck_count: 0
##     priority: "high"  # or "medium" or "low"
##     needs_retesting: false
##     status_history:
##         -working: true  # or false or "NA"
##         -agent: "main"  # or "testing" or "user"
##         -comment: "Detailed comment about status"
##
## frontend:
##   - task: "Task name"
##     implemented: true
##     working: true  # or false or "NA"
##     file: "file_path.js"
##     stuck_count: 0
##     priority: "high"  # or "medium" or "low"
##     needs_retesting: false
##     status_history:
##         -working: true  # or false or "NA"
##         -agent: "main"  # or "testing" or "user"
##         -comment: "Detailed comment about status"
##
## metadata:
##   created_by: "main_agent"
##   version: "1.0"
##   test_sequence: 0
##   run_ui: false
##
## test_plan:
##   current_focus:
##     - "Task name 1"
##     - "Task name 2"
##   stuck_tasks:
##     - "Task name with persistent issues"
##   test_all: false
##   test_priority: "high_first"  # or "sequential" or "stuck_first"
##
## agent_communication:
##     -agent: "main"  # or "testing" or "user"
##     -message: "Communication message between agents"

# Protocol Guidelines for Main agent
#
# 1. Update Test Result File Before Testing:
#    - Main agent must always update the `test_result.md` file before calling the testing agent
#    - Add implementation details to the status_history
#    - Set `needs_retesting` to true for tasks that need testing
#    - Update the `test_plan` section to guide testing priorities
#    - Add a message to `agent_communication` explaining what you've done
#
# 2. Incorporate User Feedback:
#    - When a user provides feedback that something is or isn't working, add this information to the relevant task's status_history
#    - Update the working status based on user feedback
#    - If a user reports an issue with a task that was marked as working, increment the stuck_count
#    - Whenever user reports issue in the app, if we have testing agent and task_result.md file so find the appropriate task for that and append in status_history of that task to contain the user concern and problem as well 
#
# 3. Track Stuck Tasks:
#    - Monitor which tasks have high stuck_count values or where you are fixing same issue again and again, analyze that when you read task_result.md
#    - For persistent issues, use websearch tool to find solutions
#    - Pay special attention to tasks in the stuck_tasks list
#    - When you fix an issue with a stuck task, don't reset the stuck_count until the testing agent confirms it's working
#
# 4. Provide Context to Testing Agent:
#    - When calling the testing agent, provide clear instructions about:
#      - Which tasks need testing (reference the test_plan)
#      - Any authentication details or configuration needed
#      - Specific test scenarios to focus on
#      - Any known issues or edge cases to verify
#
# 5. Call the testing agent with specific instructions referring to test_result.md
#
# IMPORTANT: Main agent must ALWAYS update test_result.md BEFORE calling the testing agent, as it relies on this file to understand what to test next.

#====================================================================================================
# END - Testing Protocol - DO NOT EDIT OR REMOVE THIS SECTION
#====================================================================================================



#====================================================================================================
# Testing Data - Main Agent and testing sub agent both should log testing data below this section
#====================================================================================================

user_problem_statement: "Build an Inventory Reservation System that prevents overselling by temporarily reserving stock during checkout. Uses MongoDB with atomic operations for concurrency-safe reservations."

backend:
  - task: "GET /api/products - List products with available stock per warehouse"
    implemented: true
    working: true
    file: "app/api/[[...path]]/route.js"
    stuck_count: 0
    priority: "high"
    needs_retesting: true
    status_history:
      - working: true
        agent: "main"
        comment: "Returns all products with inventory breakdown by warehouse. Available = totalStock - reservedStock. Tested via curl."

  - task: "GET /api/warehouses - List all warehouses"
    implemented: true
    working: true
    file: "app/api/[[...path]]/route.js"
    stuck_count: 0
    priority: "medium"
    needs_retesting: true
    status_history:
      - working: true
        agent: "main"
        comment: "Returns all warehouses with id, name, location."

  - task: "POST /api/reservations - Create reservation with concurrency control"
    implemented: true
    working: true
    file: "app/api/[[...path]]/route.js"
    stuck_count: 0
    priority: "high"
    needs_retesting: true
    status_history:
      - working: true
        agent: "main"
        comment: "Uses MongoDB atomic findOneAndUpdate with $expr for concurrency. Returns 409 when insufficient stock. Tested: two concurrent requests for last item - only one succeeds."

  - task: "POST /api/reservations/:id/confirm - Confirm reservation"
    implemented: true
    working: true
    file: "app/api/[[...path]]/route.js"
    stuck_count: 0
    priority: "high"
    needs_retesting: true
    status_history:
      - working: true
        agent: "main"
        comment: "Decreases totalStock and reservedStock, marks as confirmed. Returns 410 if expired."

  - task: "POST /api/reservations/:id/release - Release reservation"
    implemented: true
    working: true
    file: "app/api/[[...path]]/route.js"
    stuck_count: 0
    priority: "high"
    needs_retesting: true
    status_history:
      - working: true
        agent: "main"
        comment: "Decreases reservedStock, marks as released. Stock returns to available."

  - task: "Concurrency handling - Only one user can reserve last item"
    implemented: true
    working: true
    file: "app/api/[[...path]]/route.js"
    stuck_count: 0
    priority: "high"
    needs_retesting: true
    status_history:
      - working: true
        agent: "main"
        comment: "MongoDB findOneAndUpdate with $expr filter ensures atomicity. Tested: reserved last Nintendo Switch unit, second attempt got 409."

  - task: "Idempotency support via Idempotency-Key header"
    implemented: true
    working: true
    file: "app/api/[[...path]]/route.js"
    stuck_count: 0
    priority: "medium"
    needs_retesting: true
    status_history:
      - working: true
        agent: "main"
        comment: "Stores idempotency keys in MongoDB. Same key returns existing reservation with duplicate=true flag."

  - task: "Lazy expiry cleanup of reservations"
    implemented: true
    working: true
    file: "app/api/[[...path]]/route.js"
    stuck_count: 0
    priority: "medium"
    needs_retesting: true
    status_history:
      - working: true
        agent: "main"
        comment: "cleanupExpiredReservations runs on every API call. Releases expired pending reservations and updates inventory."

  - task: "POST /api/seed - Reset and reseed data"
    implemented: true
    working: true
    file: "app/api/[[...path]]/route.js"
    stuck_count: 0
    priority: "low"
    needs_retesting: true
    status_history:
      - working: true
        agent: "main"
        comment: "Clears all collections and reseeds with sample data."

  - task: "GET /api/reservations - List all reservations"
    implemented: true
    working: true
    file: "app/api/[[...path]]/route.js"
    stuck_count: 0
    priority: "medium"
    needs_retesting: true
    status_history:
      - working: true
        agent: "main"
        comment: "Returns all reservations sorted by createdAt desc, enriched with product/warehouse names."

metadata:
  created_by: "main_agent"
  version: "1.0"
  test_sequence: 1
  run_ui: false

test_plan:
  current_focus:
    - "POST /api/reservations - Create reservation with concurrency control"
    - "POST /api/reservations/:id/confirm - Confirm reservation"
    - "POST /api/reservations/:id/release - Release reservation"
    - "Concurrency handling - Only one user can reserve last item"
    - "Idempotency support via Idempotency-Key header"
  stuck_tasks: []
  test_all: true
  test_priority: "high_first"

agent_communication:
  - agent: "main"
    message: "CONVERTED to TypeScript + Prisma + Supabase PostgreSQL. All APIs use Prisma transactions with SELECT FOR UPDATE for concurrency. Database is hosted on Supabase. Please run comprehensive backend tests including: 1) Full reservation lifecycle (reserve->confirm, reserve->release), 2) Concurrency (reserve last item, try again = 409), 3) Idempotency (same key = duplicate flag), 4) Error handling (expired = 410, bad input = 400, not found = 404), 5) Seed/reseed endpoint. Base URL: http://localhost:3000/api. Start with POST /api/seed to reset data."
